the healing process of habu nephropathy is delayed in mice with a deletion of the integrin α8 subunit.
α8β1-integrin-deficiency delays glomerular regeneration after habu toxin-induced mesangial injury.
α8-integration is required for glomerular healing after mesangiopropiferative glomerular disease.

the role of α8-integrins in the regulation of mesangial cell survival and proliferation and their contribution to healing of glomeular injury.
the study of the role of the α8 integrin in the pathogenesis of renal diseases.
the role of α8-integrins in the regulation of glomerular cell survival and proliferation.

α8-integration is a regulator of mesangial cell apoptosis and proliferation and is essential for the repair process after mesangial injury.
α8-integration may be involved in the regulation of glomerular cell apoptosis and proliferation and thus may be involved in glomerular repair after injury.
